name: BBH SEO Toolkit
author: Md Jahid Shah

sections.description:
BBH SEO Toolkit is a powerful yet lightweight WordPress SEO plugin that helps you optimize your content for search engines without slowing down your site.

Key Features

  • Real-Time SEO Analysis – Get instant feedback on your content with a real-time SEO scoring based on key on-page factors including keyword targeting, content structure, and readability.
  • Focus Keyword Optimization – Analyze your content against your target keyword with detailed checks for title, URL, meta description, and content density.
  • Schema Markup (JSON-LD) – Add structured data to your posts and pages for better search engine understanding and rich snippets support.
  • XML Sitemap – Automatically generate and submit XML sitemaps to search engines for better crawling and indexing.
  • Meta Tag Management – Full control over meta titles, descriptions, and robots settings for each post and page.
  • Noindex Control – Easily hide specific pages or posts from search engines.
  • Lightweight & Fast – Built with performance in mind – no bloat, no heavy JavaScript, focused on essential SEO features.

SEO Analysis Checks

  • Keyword in title (exact and partial matches)
  • Keyword in meta description
  • Keyword in URL slug
  • Keyword usage analysis (avoid overuse or underuse)
  • Keyword in first paragraph
  • Content length (minimum 300 words recommended)
  • Heading hierarchy (H1, H2, H3 structure)
  • Sentence readability
  • Meta description length (120-160 characters)
  • Featured image presence
  • Internal and external links
  • Webmaster verification support (Google, Bing, Yandex, Pinterest, and Meta)

Our All Plugins

  • BBH SEO Toolkit – Optimize your website content for better visibility and traffic.
  • BBH Custom Schema – Add custom JSON-LD schema markup to your website.
  • BBH Redirection – Create and manage 301 redirects easily.
  • AJ FAQ Block – Display FAQs with a beautiful block
  • AJ Card Element – Display content in beautiful cards
  • AJ Square Testimonial Slider – Showcase testimonials in a slider
  • AJ Category Posts – Display posts by category
  • AJx Filter for WooCommerce – Advanced product filtering for WooCommerce

Support & Contact

Need help or want to report an issue? Visit our support page or open a support ticket on the WordPress plugin repository.

  • Website: https://jahidshah.com/
  • Support: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/bbh-seo-toolkit/
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for BBH SEO Toolkit
  4. Click Install Now and activate the plugin
  5. Configure your SEO settings in the plugin settings page

Or install manually:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Unzip and upload the bbh-seo-toolkit folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins and click Activate
  4. Configure your SEO settings in the plugin settings page
sections.faq:
How do I use the SEO analysis feature?

Simply add a focus keyword to any post or page in the SEO Settings meta box. The plugin will automatically analyze your content and provide real-time feedback on your SEO optimization.

Does this plugin work with my theme?

Yes! BBH SEO Toolkit works with any WordPress theme. The SEO meta box appears in the post/page editor sidebar on all standard post types.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

BBH SEO Toolkit is designed to be lightweight and fast, adding minimal overhead and performance impact.

Do I need to configure anything to get started?

Just install and activate the plugin. The default settings work well for most sites. You can customize meta settings per post/page in the editor.

Does it include schema markup?

Yes, BBH SEO Toolkit includes schema markup support. You can add custom JSON-LD schema to your posts and pages.

How do I generate an XML sitemap?

The XML sitemap is generated automatically. Access it at /sitemap.xml on your site. Submit this URL to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.

Can I hide specific pages from search engines?

Yes, simply check the “Hide from search engines” option in the SEO Settings meta box for any post or page.
